instruction: Configure your Thunderbird email signature in plain text: first line "Tom Harris", second line "Product Manager".

metadata.explanation: Two-line signature with role. Identical complexity to original - just different content.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric. Signature text verified to match regex escape requirements for special characters (dots, plus signs).

llm_judge_reasons: Instruction explicitly requires 'plain text' signature, but evaluator only checks htmlSigText field without verifying the signature format mode
Missing verification of mail.identity.id1.htmlSigFormat setting, which should be false for plain text signatures
The evaluator would pass even if the signature is configured in HTML mode, as long as the text content matches
Incomplete coverage: only checks signature content (Tom Harris\nProduct Manager) but not the format type requirement
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add expected rule for mail.identity.id1.htmlSigFormat with value false to ensure plain text mode is enabled
Consider checking mail.identity.id1.htmlSigText for the signature content AND mail.identity.id1.htmlSigFormat=false in the same evaluator
Alternative: if plain text signatures use a different preference key (e.g., mail.identity.id1.sig_file or plain text field), the evaluator should check that key instead

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
